updates.title: Claude Code gives me very few models to work with, and that's exactly why I keep going back to it
updates.summary: The XDA author argues that Claude Code's intentionally narrow model roster — only Anthropic's own Haiku, Sonnet, Opus, and the Fable/Mythos frontier tier — is a feature rather than a flaw. By contrast, tools like Cursor present a sprawling multi-vendor picker (OpenAI, Google, xAI, Anthropic) that turns every prompt into a micro-procurement decision. The article contends that because Anthropic's models consistently top coding benchmarks, the constrained selection removes decision fatigue without sacrificing quality.
updates.accuracy_notes: Opinion/review piece from an XDA staff writer based on first-hand use; no factual claims require independent verification. Assertion that Anthropic models lead coding benchmarks is consistent with publicly available AIDER leaderboard data and SWE-bench rankings. Claude Code model lineup accurately described.

updates.title: Inference Hooks for Claude Enterprise now in beta — real-time DLP enforcement before Claude sees your prompts
updates.summary: Anthropic launched Inference Hooks in beta for Claude Enterprise on August 5, 2026, enabling organizations to route every employee prompt through their own security server for an allow-or-deny verdict before the model processes it. The feature extends DLP (data loss prevention) enforcement — the same controls already applied to email and web traffic — to Claude Chat, Claude Code, and Cowork sessions via a single organization-level configuration. Supported DLP infrastructure includes Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, and Proofpoint, and includes shadow mode and rollout controls for staged deployments.
updates.accuracy_notes: Official Anthropic release note confirmed by coverage from The Next Web (thenextweb.com), Unite.AI, and AIToolsReview. August 5, 2026 launch date corroborated by multiple independent sources. DLP vendor integrations (Netskope, Palo Alto, Zscaler, Proofpoint) confirmed via multiple secondary sources. Beta status clearly disclosed.
